entries.4fb83de931103735: This is a single-segment retail business that operates supercenters, mainly in rural areas, that comprehensively handle daily necessities across all areas of food, clothing and shelter. Sales by product category for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥65,228 million for Foods, ¥32,122 million for Non-Foods, and ¥413 million for Other (rental income from real estate). The number of stores is 23.
